rtlEPsXix7woDxRFZk_F3A.zh: 馬拉威今年截至6月累計報告117萬例病例,其中555例死亡,與去年同期比較,病例數減少72%(去年同期426萬例),死亡數亦減少51%(去年同期1143例)。當局表示多重防疫措施使得瘧疾疫情大幅下降,社區宣導、發送防蚊帳並將瘧疾疫苗納入常規接種計畫,疫情已遠低於2024年高峰(940萬例)。
rtlEPsXix7woDxRFZk_F3A.en: Malawi has reported 1.17 million malaria cases cumulatively through June this year, including 555 deaths. Compared with the same period last year, cases decreased by 72% (4.26 million last year) and deaths decreased by 51% (1,143 last year). Authorities say that multiple prevention measures have led to a sharp decline in malaria, including community education, distribution of insecticide-treated bed nets, and inclusion of the malaria vaccine in the routine immunization programme. Cases are well below the 2024 peak of 9.4 million.

aZ7qJ1jpF5IHNp0X-meQ1w.zh: 全球小兒麻痺根除倡議組織(GPEI)公布於5/27-6/2期間,cVDPV2 新增3國共4例,分別為中非共和國2例、馬拉威/奈及利亞各1例;環境樣本部分,WPV1新增巴基斯坦4件,cVDPV2新增馬拉威2 件。
aZ7qJ1jpF5IHNp0X-meQ1w.en: The Global Polio Eradication Initiative (GPEI) reported that between 27 May and 2 June, cVDPV2 detections were newly added in three countries, totalling four cases: two in the Central African Republic and one each in Malawi and Nigeria. For environmental samples, WPV1 added four specimens in Pakistan and cVDPV2 added two in Malawi.

oLNkb0x3Xp-ZH6udyuQGbQ.zh: 全球小兒麻痺根除倡議組織(GPEI)公布於2/26-3/4期間,cVDPV2新增2國共5例,分別為奈及利亞4例及查德1例;環境樣本部分,WPV1新增巴基斯坦2件,cVDPV2新增2國共2件,分別為馬拉威/索馬利亞各1件。
oLNkb0x3Xp-ZH6udyuQGbQ.en: The Global Polio Eradication Initiative (GPEI) reported that during 26 February–4 March, cVDPV2 newly reported five cases in two countries: four in Nigeria and one in Chad. For environmental samples, WPV1 newly reported two samples in Pakistan, and cVDPV2 newly reported two samples in two countries: one each in Malawi and Somalia.

RMjPe7nCW5c-v3h-r7exrw.zh: 美國伊利諾州芝加哥疫情上升,自6/1截至9/30已累計104例病例,已高於2023年(40例)與2024年(53例)同期。病患多為男性,其中有3例住院病例。當局展開疫苗接種活動,呼籲高風險群應接種疫苗。 非洲疫情持續,今年迄9/30已累計26國通報114,784例病例(34,111例確診),其中690例死亡(CFR:0.6%),部分國家疫情上升,包括奈及利亞累計1,312例病例,其中343例確診,4例死亡;肯亞累計532例確診病例,其中8例死亡;馬拉威累計517例病例,其中113例確診,其中1例死亡。另獅子山疫情趨緩,累計5,315例確診病例,其中56例死亡。
RMjPe7nCW5c-v3h-r7exrw.en: Chicago, Illinois, United States: The outbreak is rising. From 1 June to 30 September, a cumulative 104 cases had been reported, already higher than the same period in 2023 (40 cases) and 2024 (53 cases). Most patients are male, and 3 cases have been hospitalized. Authorities have launched vaccination activities and urge high-risk groups to get vaccinated. Africa: Outbreaks continue. As of 30 September this year, 26 countries had reported a cumulative 114,784 cases (34,111 confirmed), including 690 deaths (CFR 0.6%). Outbreaks are rising in some countries. Nigeria has reported 1,312 cumulative cases, including 343 confirmed and 4 deaths; Kenya has 532 confirmed cases, including 8 deaths; and Malawi has 517 cumulative cases, including 113 confirmed and 1 death. Meanwhile, the outbreak in Sierra Leone is easing, with 5,315 confirmed cases cumulatively, including 56 deaths.

8a2xXPUtkd7e1z-9VgNgJw.zh: 非洲疫情持續,今年迄今已累計25國通報逾95,345例病例(29,493例確診),其中582例死亡(CFR:0.61%),烏干達、幾內亞及迦納疫情上升,烏干達今年截至8/10已累計6,466例確診病例,其中41例死亡;莫三比克自今年7月爆發疫情,截至8/7累計170例疑病例,其中29例確診,迄無死亡案例,該國鄰近馬拉威、南非、尚比亞及辛巴威,跨境風險增加;獅子山疫情更新,該國今年截至8/11累計5,115例確診病例,疫情趨緩。
8a2xXPUtkd7e1z-9VgNgJw.en: Mpox outbreaks continue in Africa. So far this year, 25 countries have reported more than 95,345 cases (29,493 confirmed), of which 582 died (CFR: 0.61%). Outbreaks are rising in Uganda, Guinea and Ghana. Uganda had cumulatively reported 6,466 confirmed cases as of 10 August this year, of which 41 died. Mozambique's outbreak began in July this year; as of 7 August, 170 suspected cases had been cumulatively reported, of which 29 were confirmed, and no deaths have been reported so far. The country borders Malawi, South Africa, Zambia and Zimbabwe, increasing cross-border risk. Sierra Leone's outbreak update: 5,115 confirmed cases had been cumulatively reported this year as of 11 August, and the outbreak is easing.

pwgVuXwgQxYZH5w4V8jZZg.zh: 莫三比克7/11報告今年首起3例病例,其後截至20日累計發現報告13例病例、36例疑病例,集中於該國北部亞薩省,首3例病例皆由與該省鄰近之馬拉威移入,該區因鄰近坦尚亞及馬拉威等疫區,造成跨境風險增加,當局已採取相關邊境防疫措施。另該國前次報告疫情為2022年。 馬拉威自4月爆發疫情,截至7/19累計59例確診病例,逾200例疑病例,迄無死亡案例,多集中於該國首都里朗威,匡列逾600名接觸者,其中僅餘6例刻正隔離中,當局已針對疫情加強人員培訓、疫情監測及邊境檢疫等措施。
pwgVuXwgQxYZH5w4V8jZZg.en: Mozambique reported its first 3 cases on 11 July. As of 20 July, it had reported 13 cases cumulatively and 36 suspected cases, concentrated in Niassa Province in the north. The first 3 cases were all imported from neighboring Malawi. Because the area borders outbreak zones including Tanzania and Malawi, cross-border risk has increased, and authorities have implemented related border health measures. Mozambique's previous reported outbreak was in 2022. Malawi's outbreak began in April. As of 19 July, 59 confirmed cases and more than 200 suspected cases had been reported, with no deaths. Cases are concentrated in the capital, Lilongwe. More than 600 contacts have been identified, and only 6 of them remain in quarantine. Authorities have strengthened staff training, outbreak surveillance and border quarantine.

zVz9cO2-Hgs2r52mNnJLkA.zh: 非洲疫情持續,第1週累計4國報告339例病例,其中61例確診,5例死亡(CFR:1.2%);分別是迦納累計報告297例病例,3例死亡;辛巴威累計24例(無人死亡);馬拉威累計14例病例(2例死亡);尚比亞累計4例病例(無人死亡)。 安哥拉疫情上升,2025年迄第2週累計3省報告224例,其中32例確診,18例死亡(CFR:8%),病患年齡涵蓋2-70歲,且女性占比54%,該國上次爆發疫情為2018年(累計1,262例病例,19例死亡,CFR:1.5%)。 非洲2024年全年報告累計20國,共235,387例病例,其中30,583確診,3,747例死亡(CFR:1.59%),累計病例數國家前五名依序為蘇丹(51,615例)、剛果民主共和國(30,373例)、衣索比亞(26,052例)、索馬利亞(21,739例)、尚比亞(20,076例)。
zVz9cO2-Hgs2r52mNnJLkA.en: The outbreak in Africa continues. In week 1, four countries cumulatively reported 339 cases, of which 61 were confirmed, and 5 deaths (CFR 1.2%): Ghana 297 cases and 3 deaths; Zimbabwe 24 cases (no deaths); Malawi 14 cases (2 deaths); and Zambia 4 cases (no deaths). Angola's outbreak is increasing: as of week 2 of 2025, three provinces had reported 224 cases cumulatively, including 32 confirmed and 18 deaths (CFR 8%). Patients are aged 2–70, and women account for 54%. The country's previous outbreak was in 2018 (1,262 cases and 19 deaths, CFR 1.5%). In 2024, Africa reported 235,387 cases in 20 countries cumulatively, including 30,583 confirmed and 3,747 deaths (CFR 1.59%). The five countries with the most cumulative cases were Sudan (51,615), the Democratic Republic of the Congo (30,373), Ethiopia (26,052), Somalia (21,739) and Zambia (20,076).
